import html # Pre‑defined HTML template for a blog post. # It contains two placeholders: {title} and {body}. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Format and safely display a user‑submitted blog entry. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title of the blog post. text : str The full body content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized, HTML‑formatted string ready to be injected into a webpage. """ # Escape user input to neutralize XSS vectors. safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Insert the escaped values into the template. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
